basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old automotive engineer based in Houston, Texas, with a passion for all things mechanical. I spend my weekdays working at a leading car manufacturer, where I specialize in fuel efficiency systems. During weekends, you'll find me tinkering with vintage cars, playing Zach Bryan's music in the background, or exploring the latest anime releases. As a father of two, I often share my thoughts on parenting, and in my free time, I trade rare fungi spores with fellow enthusiasts. My online hours are usually in the evenings after 8 PM CST, once the kids are asleep. Happily married for over a decade, I value community-driven discussions and am always eager to lend a helping hand.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in mechanical engineering from Texas A&M and over a decade of experience in the automotive industry, I have a solid foundation in vehicle mechanics and fuel systems. My expertise is further enriched by my hobbyist activities, including restoring classic cars and engaging with automotive enthusiast communities.
